title: 10AN to 1 1/16 - 12 SAE
description:
Founded in 2008, ColorFittings is an industry leader in premium automotive, marine, and aviation plumbing products. 

Whether you’re a professional building a 6-second NHRA bracket car, a perfectionist designing the ultimate engine bay for a SEMA car, or an HPDE enthusiast looking to improve your oil temps, our products are designed for all flavors of motorsports. 

ColorFittings products are carefully machined from 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum and finished with our proprietary polish and anodizing process. 

Available in unique gloss-finish colors, these AN Fittings are specifically designed for use with high-quality PTFE hose.

AN Hose applications pair excellently with our lightweight Hose Separators, which are available in unique gloss-finish colors.

For a hassle-free installation process, we strongly recommend using our Fitting Assembly Tools.
